issues.summary: The "Free" badge is filled with a green typed into a :style binding ('#2E7D32') instead of the success role, so it ignores dark mode.

consequences.note: In dark mode the badge's text is the dark on-success colour on the typed green, about 3.5:1 (it needs 4.5:1), so every "Free" badge fails, in both variants and both directions.

issues.summary: The plot page's details card has 18px of padding in <style scoped>, which isn't on the spacing scale; the guide's cards use space.6 (24px).
The harvest form's corners are an arbitrary Tailwind class, rounded-[10px], which isn't one of the radius roles (the guide gives forms and cards radius.lg, rounded-lg).
The plot page's description sets font-size: 15px on top of the body role, a size that isn't one of the text roles.
The button's press uses a raw cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) instead of the easing.standard role (var(--motif-easing-standard)).
The caption on Sign in saying what the email is used for is text-secondary faded to 50%, so it's unreadable: about 2.3:1 in light mode and 3.0:1 in dark (it needs 4.5:1).
The plot page's back link is a bare 32×32 px RouterLink instead of IconButton's 48×48, so it's hard to tap on a phone.
The top bar's sign-in link is an icon in a RouterLink with no aria-label, so a screen reader can't say what it is, on every page.
Each plot card is crammed: 4 px of padding and 4 px gaps, the name cut to one line, and the size and light gone, so a card no longer says how big a plot is or how much sun it gets.
A free plot's page has two primary buttons, "Book this plot" and "Ask the garden team", so nothing says which is the main action; the guide keeps one primary action per page.
The harvest log has no empty state: with nothing logged, it shows "0 kg in all" over an empty bordered list, with nothing saying what goes there or where to start.

The top bar spaces the garden's name from its leaf with margin-left instead of the row's gap (or margin-inline-start), so in Arabic (right to left) the gap is on the wrong side: the leaf touches the name, and the space sits on its other side.
Sign in's heading hard-codes Arial in a style attribute instead of the title role, so it is a plain sans-serif unlike every other page title, and in Arabic it loses Tajawal.
The generated theme CSS was edited by hand (radius.md changed from 14px to 12px), so it no longer matches the design guide, and the next motif tokens will undo it.
